thread:
maria: deploy-bot showing a failed publish for router:v1.12.3 to prod-eu-ecr — provenance check failed on the manifest list (missing platform annotation). tag=v1.12.3, digest=sha256:abc123def... can we pin and promote a previous digest? need rollback plan and who can override

deploy-bot: Publish failed: ECR AttestationMissing: provenance.platform annotation missing for manifest list. HTTP 400. manifest: sha256:abc123def... logs: https://logs.internal/builds/6722 :warning:

alex: ok. we can retag the previous stable digest (sha256:zzz789) -> v1.12.3-pin and promote. that should bypass the provenance guard since it already has attestation. quick question: do we want a temp tag or overwrite v1.12.3?

devops: policy: deploy-bot will refuse retagging to an existing tag without override. manual promote requires override role (deploy-approver). We can run: `deploy-bot promote --force --reason "emergency pin"` but product + security approval required

maria: product signs off for emergency rollback/pin for the release window. security — any objections? also we should record in release notes and change window

claire (security): i can approve for this window if we 1) backfill the missing annotation on the original manifest list and 2) schedule a cosign key rotation within 24h. keep audit log of the override.

alex: plan: 1) retag previous digest: `gcr.io/redwood/router@sha256:zzz789 -> tag v1.12.3-pin` 2) promote pin to prod canary 3) backfill annotation on the problematic manifest and re-run publish job to staging 4) rotate cosign key & document. anyone object?

sre-oncall: sounds fine. ops note: if pinned promote causes regressions, rollback path = point service back to v1.12.2 (previous stable) and abort auto-rollout. set 30min monitoring window with alerts for 5xx and p95 latency. mark on-call aware.

devops: i'm initiating the manual retag + promote. command: `deploy-bot retag --from-digest sha256:zzz789 --to-tag v1.12.3-pin --apply` opening release-notes PR now. tagging @claire for audit entry.

deploy-bot: Retag job queued: job_id=6722, user=devops. status=queued -> running -> succeeded. pushed `v1.12.3-pin` to prod-eu-ecr.

devops: job 6722 succeeded. promoting canary now: `deploy-bot promote --tag v1.12.3-pin --env canary --notes "emergency pin - provenance backfill in progress"`

maria: canary looks clean after 12m. no errors in logs, p95 within threshold. starting gradual rollout to prod. filing an incident ticket to track provenance backfill and cosign rotation (INC-2026-54).

claire (security): audit note: override approved by claire (security) for release window. requirement: backfill annotation and re-run original publish job within 4h.

sre-oncall: monitoring window set. if anything spikes revert to v1.12.2 and ping this thread.

maria: thanks all — closing thread after backfill completed. will update INC-2026-54 with final notes and release-notes PR link.
